description: Path A: per-term symbolic u-pole-order analysis of the proton's tr_M = Σ_λ y_λ(q) · χ^λ_q(β_{1,0}) at q = u² (per the D(u) convention).  Loads cached symbolic y_λ from y-lambda-wenzl-bridge-symbolic-witness.json and cached chi_λ from chi-proton-h3.witness.json (auto-emit on first run, multiprocessing).  Per-term ord_{u=0}(y_λ · χ^λ) avoids the sp.together bottleneck.  Verifies shift_NF(β_proton) = 19 = 18·1 + 21·0 + 1, matching prop:per-nucleon-shift-additive-linearity.

per_generator_crossings.note: Canonical crossings from atom_canonical_crossings(Z, N), aggregated per generator index.  Provides structural baseline for GAP-C-1 (q-integer counting per generator) in derivation-audit-report.md.  KLR-canonical-class enrichment per AGENTS.md §7b (and PR #608 KLR cemetery infra): each per-generator sub-word σ_g^k (pure power) is a cemetery class trivially; the full atom's canonical class is the per-partition χ-fingerprint at q_0 (emitted as `atom_chi_fingerprint` below).

atom_chi_fingerprint.note: Per-partition χ^λ(β_atom; q_0) tuple — heuristic comparison hash for braid/Markov-equivalence at q_0.  It is a NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT condition for canonical-basis (KL) equivalence: identical fingerprints are evidence of equivalence, but two distinct canonical-basis classes can collide at the rounded-trace level (no iff guarantee).  Trace-only form because per-block matrices are not currently materialised at H_n>3 in Path A — full equivalence requires the per-block matrix entries (cf. r5_full_canonical_knot_solver.chi_fingerprint at H_3). Per Copilot review #r3213426336.

lean_uniqueness_ref.note: T_w uniqueness at the abstract empty-constraint SDP level (PR #1537/#1542 parameterised module). Workplan: docs/workplans/2026-05-31-witness-lean-uniqueness-ref-wiring.md.
